build.buildCommand: PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 npm install --workspace @gvs/web --include-workspace-root --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --workspace @gvs/web
build.comment: Scoped to this service's workspace. apps/mobile is an npm workspace too, and an unscoped install at the repo root drags React Native, Firebase, VisionCamera and the rest of the Android toolchain into a deployment that will never run them — 1108 packages instead of ~245, and a much larger image. --include-workspace-root keeps @gvs/shared linked.
